definitions.explanation: Treating something or someone as more important or giving them first consideration over others.

examples.japanese: {安全|あんぜん}を{優先|ゆうせん}する。
{歩行者|ほこうしゃ}{優先|ゆうせん}の{道路|どうろ}では{車|くるま}は{徐行|じょこう}しなければならない。
examples.english: On pedestrian-priority roads, vehicles must slow down.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}よりも{家族|かぞく}を{優先|ゆうせん}したいと{考|かんが}えるようになった。
examples.english: I've come to want to prioritize family over work.

notes:
FORMATION: {優|ゆう} (superior, excellent) + {先|せん} (ahead, first). Literally 'ahead in superiority.'

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [A]を{優先|ゆうせん}する (to prioritize A)
- [A]に{優先|ゆうせん}する (to take precedence over A)
- [A]より[B]を{優先|ゆうせん}する (to prioritize B over A)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {優先順位|ゆうせんじゅんい}: priority ranking, order of priority
- {優先席|ゆうせんせき}: priority seating (on trains)
- {最優先|さいゆうせん}: top priority
- {優先権|ゆうせんけん}: right of priority, priority rights
- {優先的|ゆうせんてき}に: preferentially, with priority
